summary: This is a Form 6-K by foreign private issuer MakeMyTrip Ltd, reporting its unaudited financial results for Q4 and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The press release highlights record gross bookings of $10.4 billion and double-digit growth in adjusted margins across all segments. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or corporate actions. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no special situation or corporate event triggering classification under any special-situations category.
